Jean Carroll, No. 26-141, or United States v. E. Jean Carroll, et al., No. 26-142, including any consolidation of those petitions before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A ruling qualifies only if it leaves none of the February 8, 2024 judgment enforceable against Donald J. Trump.

The ruling must:
Be issued by the U.S. Supreme Court in Donald J. Trump v. E. Jean Carroll, No. 26-141, or United States v. E. Jean Carroll, et al., No. 26-142, including any consolidation of those petitions
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
A grant or denial of certiorari, stay, briefing order, scheduling order, or other order that does not itself overturn the full judgment
A ruling on presidential immunity, Westfall Act substitution, or another procedural issue that does not require the full judgment to be vacated or set aside
A partial reversal, damages reduction, modification, GVR, or remand that does not itself require the full judgment to be vacated or set aside
A ruling in Carroll II, No. 25-573, or another separate Carroll proceeding
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders

For clarity:
A ruling in either No. 26-141 or No. 26-142 counts if it matches the specified judgment
Per curiam opinions and summary orders count if they match the specified judgment
If multiple justices issue separate opinions, the majority or plurality opinion controls

markets.rules_primary: If an exit tax on individuals has been enacted in Italy after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

For this market, an exit tax on individuals means a tax imposed by Italy on individuals' accrued but unrealized gains on financial investments, such as shares, securities or crypto-assets, because they transfer their tax residence outside Italy. The tax rate, asset threshold, prior-residency requirement and payment terms may differ from the proposal in Italy's 2027 budget bill. The measure may contain other provisions and may use any legislative vehicle.

The following do NOT count:

Passage of the 2027 budget law with the exit tax removed
Proposals, announcements and draft bills
Exit taxes that apply only to companies or business assets
A decree-law that has not been converted into law by Parliament

Enactment is measured when the law is promulgated by the President of the Republic and published in the Gazzetta Ufficiale, not when the tax takes effect.

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

markets.rules_primary: If legislation that limits the number of terms or years a person may serve as Israel's prime minister is enacted in Israel before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, a prime minister term limit means a law of Israel, including an amendment to Basic Law: The Government or to another Basic Law, that limits the number of terms or years a person may serve as Prime Minister of Israel, whether it counts consecutive or total service. It may contain other provisions, may include a cooling-off period, and may apply only to future prime ministers or take effect after a later election.

A bill that has not passed the Knesset in its third reading, including one approved only in a preliminary or first reading or by a Knesset committee, a law that only bars a prime minister from serving while under indictment, and a law that limits tenure in another office do NOT count. Enactment is complete when the Knesset passes the law in its third reading and it is published in Reshumot, the Official Gazette; no further ratification is needed.

markets.rules_secondary:
Impeached means the U.S. House of Representatives adopts at least one article of impeachment against the official in a floor vote. Committee votes, and resolutions that are tabled, referred or defeated, do not count. The first official is the one against whom the House first adopts an article of impeachment after Issuance. If a single vote impeaches more than one named official, the market will resolve to 1 / N where N is the number of named officials impeached by that vote.

Only the six officials named in this event are compared, and no officials will be added to this event. The impeachment of an official who is not named in this event does not resolve any market, and the first named official the House impeaches afterwards is still the first official for this market.

None of these resolves to Yes if, after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, the House does not impeach any of the six officials named in this event. It resolves to No as soon as the House impeaches one of them after Issuance.

markets.rules_primary: If Todd Blanche is subpoenaed by a vote of a committee or subcommittee of the U.S. House of Representatives after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency before Jan 1, 2028.

A person is subpoenaed by a committee vote only if a committee or subcommittee of the U.S. House of Representatives, including a select committee, takes a recorded or voice vote that approves a subpoena to that person or authorizes the chair to issue one to that person. A subpoena for documents, testimony, or both qualifies. The vote counts when it is taken, even if the subpoena is signed, served, or complied with later or never. A single vote covering several people counts for each of them.

The following do NOT count:
A subpoena issued by a chair or other member without a committee or subcommittee vote
A motion to subpoena that fails, is tabled, or is not put to a vote
A vote held before Issuance
A vote by a Senate committee
A subpoena addressed only to a company, agency, or office without naming the person

markets.rules_primary: If the government of Greenland officially calls a snap parliamentary election after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from Bloomberg News, Reuters, KNR, or Sermitsiaq qualifies. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify unless the new publication explicitly reaffirms the truth of the topic as of its publication date. Republishing of content from other sources qualifies only if hosted on the outlet’s official platform with that outlet identified as publisher.

A snap election is one called to occur at least 90 days earlier than either the previously scheduled election date or the latest date legally required. The announcement must be made by a person or body with the legal authority to call the election and must specify an actual election date.

This market concerns elections to Greenland’s Inatsisartut. Demands, speculation, coalition negotiations, and an election merely being held do not constitute an official call.

markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from Bloomberg News, Reuters, KNR, or Sermitsiaq qualifies. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify unless the new publication explicitly reaffirms the truth of the topic as of its publication date. markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If legislation that adds or widens a legal ground for abortion, extends the gestational limit, or removes criminal liability for abortion or for assisting one is enacted in Georgia before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, a law easing Georgia's abortion ban means a statute of Georgia that adds or widens a statutory ground on which abortion is legal, such as a new exception or a gestational limit later than the cardiac-activity cutoff of the 2019 LIFE Act (HB 481), or that removes criminal liability, in whole or in part, for abortion or for assisting one. It may contain other provisions and need not repeal the ban. A law providing that a woman may not be prosecuted for ending her own pregnancy counts.

Rulings of the Georgia Supreme Court or any other court, executive orders, and measures that only change hospital procedures, reporting or funding, or only restate or protect care already permitted under existing exceptions, without adding or widening a ground or removing criminal liability do NOT count. Passage by the General Assembly alone, and a bill the Governor has vetoed without the General Assembly overriding it, do NOT count.
markets.title: Will Georgia enact a law easing its abortion ban before Jul 1, 2027?

markets.rules_primary: If a measure lowering the minimum age to claim a pension under the general retirement rules is enacted in France before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For the purposes of this Contract, the legal retirement age refers to the minimum age to claim a pension under the general age rules in Article L. 161-17-2 of the Social Security Code or any replacement provision. A measure counts only if it sets the legal retirement age for at least one birth cohort below the age in effect at Issuance for people becoming eligible at that time. A suspension, freeze or delay of a scheduled increase does NOT count. A cut in the general rules for one or more birth cohorts counts; a lower age limited to an occupation, a category of workers, parents, or people with long careers or an early start to work does NOT count. Changes limited to contribution requirements, the age for an automatic full pension, special early-retirement exceptions, or leave before pension eligibility do NOT count.

Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law. Final adoption by Parliament, including a text deemed adopted under Article 49, paragraph 3, of the Constitution, does NOT count until the President promulgates the law. The date of promulgation shown in the Journal officiel de la République française governs for legislation. A measure counts once enacted, even if the age reduction takes effect later.

markets.rules_primary: If the United States Department of Commerce announces the addition of Megaspeed as an expressly named entity to the Entity List before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only an entry that expressly names the company counts: its own name, a former name, or an alias (a.k.a. or f.k.a.) listed in the entry. The entry may use the company's full legal name, such as Megaspeed International for Megaspeed or ChangXin Memory Technologies for CXMT. A listing of Megaspeed does not count for Speedmatrix, or the reverse, unless the entry also names the other company itself or as an alias.

The Entity List is the list in Supplement No. 4 to Part 744 of the Export Administration Regulations. A listing counts when the Department of Commerce announces it in any official way, such as a press release, a posting on the Bureau of Industry and Security website or publication in the Federal Register, regardless of the rule's effective date.

The following do NOT count:
Coverage of the company only as an affiliate, subsidiary or parent of a listed entity, including under the affiliates rule (50 percent rule)
A listing that names only a different company, even one with a similar name or the same address
Placement on the Unverified List, the Military End-User List, a Temporary Denial Order or a sanctions list
A report or statement that a listing has been approved or is under consideration but has not been announced
markets.title: Will the United States Department of Commerce announce the addition of Megaspeed as an expressly named entity to the Entity List before Jan 1, 2028?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If a data center moratorium is enacted in Alabama before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A data center moratorium is a legally binding state action, such as a statute, executive order, regulation, or agency or utility-commission order, that categorically prohibits or suspends at least one approval, permit, utility interconnection, or other pathway that new or expanded data centers need to proceed.

It must apply throughout the state, not only in particular localities or regions. A utility-commission order counts if it covers every utility the commission regulates. It may cover only a defined class of data centers, such as by power demand, water use, size, or new versus expanded status, and may exempt existing facilities, approved projects, or applications past a specified stage. It need not be called a moratorium, and a permanent prohibition also qualifies.

It counts once it is operative and mandatory for the agencies, regulators, or utilities responsible for the affected pathway, even if it later expires, is repealed, or is enjoined.

The following do NOT qualify:

Holds or denials affecting a single project or developer
Restrictions on the sale, lease, or other disposition of state-owned property
Changes to tax exemptions, subsidies, or other financial incentives
Studies, reports, task forces, or nonbinding requests
New requirements that a project can proceed by satisfying
Measures that only slow or add review to applications
markets.title: Will Alabama enact a data center moratorium before 2028?

It may cover only a defined class of data centers, such as by power demand, water use, size, or new versus expanded status, and may exempt existing facilities, approved projects, or applications past a specified stage. It need not be called a moratorium, and a permanent prohibition also qualifies.

It counts once it is operative and mandatory for the agencies, regulators, or utilities responsible for the affected pathway, even if it later expires, is repealed, or is enjoined.

Holds or denials affecting a single project or developer
Restrictions on the sale, lease, or other disposition of state-owned property
Changes to tax exemptions, subsidies, or other financial incentives
Studies, reports, task forces, or nonbinding requests
New requirements that a project can proceed by satisfying
Measures that only slow or add review to applications

markets.rules_primary: If Chile and Bolivia agree to or announce the restoration of full diplomatic relations between them at the ambassadorial level before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying agreement or announcement is a joint decision or statement by Chile and Bolivia, or contemporaneous official statements from both governments, committing to restore diplomatic relations at the ambassadorial level, including by exchanging ambassadors. A commitment to restore full diplomatic relations, or relations at the highest diplomatic level, counts. It qualifies even if it takes effect later or names no ambassadors. An announcement that the two countries are restoring or re-establishing diplomatic relations, without stating a level, also counts unless the same announcement places the relations below ambassadorial level.

Naming an ambassador, or an announcement by only one government, qualifies only if the other government also confirms it. Statements that the two countries will work or advance toward normalization without committing to restore relations at the ambassadorial level, meetings of the Mecanismo de Consultas Políticas, and relations restored only below the ambassadorial level (such as consulates general or chargés d'affaires) do not qualify. A retraction is not itself a qualifying announcement, and a retraction after a qualifying agreement does not undo it; this market closes and expires early when the agreement is made.

An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments

markets.rules_primary: If California achieves the superior outcome in the trial-level resolution of its Nov 16, 2026 AI safety lawsuit against OpenAI after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For this market, the case is The People of the State of California v. OpenAI Foundation, OpenAI Group PBC, and Does 1-100, filed Nov 16, 2026 in the Superior Court of California, County of San Francisco.

California achieves the superior outcome through the following exclusive hierarchy:

Net Monetary Recovery (Highest Priority): California achieves the superior outcome if it receives a larger net monetary award than all opposing parties combined (after offsetting any awards against California). Attorney's fees and costs are excluded.

Substantive Legal Victory (Second Priority): If no net monetary advantage exists, California achieves the superior outcome if it prevails on claims seeking the largest dollar amount of relief in its original pleadings, or if relief amounts are equal or unclear, on the greater number of primary causes of action. Injunctive relief counts as a substantive victory only if it provides the primary relief sought in the original pleadings.

Case Termination Advantage (Third Priority): If the case terminates without substantive judgment, California achieves the superior outcome if opposing parties voluntarily dismiss all claims against California with prejudice. All other termination scenarios result in no superior outcome for any party.

Settlements: California achieves the superior outcome if the parties settle with a disclosed net payment to California. California does not achieve the superior outcome if the parties settle with a disclosed net payment from California to opposing parties. No party achieves a superior outcome if the parties settle with mutual releases and no disclosed payment direction, or if settlement terms are sealed and no Source Agency reports payment direction within seven days of the settlement announcement.

Key exclusions: This applies only to trial-level resolution and excludes all appeals processes. Procedural victories alone do not constitute superior outcomes. A temporary restraining order, preliminary injunction, or expedited-discovery order does NOT constitute a final trial-level resolution. A dismissal that leaves claims pending does NOT constitute a final trial-level resolution.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the government of British Columbia calls a snap provincial election after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

A snap election is one called to occur at least 90 days earlier than either the previously scheduled election date or the latest date legally required. The announcement must be made by a person or body with the legal authority to call the election and must specify an actual election date.

markets.rules_primary: If a resolution finding a Cabinet member in contempt of Congress has passed the House after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A resolution counts only if the full House adopts it on the floor, by recorded vote, voice vote or unanimous consent. It may rely on criminal referral, civil enforcement or inherent contempt, and a resolution recommending that the House find the person in contempt counts when the House adopts it.

A Cabinet member is a person who, when the House votes, is the Vice President, the head or acting head of an executive department, or another official listed as a member of the Cabinet on the White House website (https://www.whitehouse.gov/administration/cabinet/).

The following do NOT count:
A committee or subcommittee vote to report or recommend a contempt resolution
A resolution that is introduced, referred, tabled or defeated
A resolution that authorizes a lawsuit to enforce a subpoena without finding the person in contempt
A finding of contempt of court
A vote or resolution of the Senate
A resolution against a person who has already left the Cabinet when the House votes

markets.rules_primary: If federal legislation authorizing government-initiated AI shutdowns has become law after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying federal law must expressly authorize the U.S. government to initiate the shutdown, suspension, or technical disabling of an operating AI model or system to address safety or security risks or loss of control. The government may act directly or compel a developer, operator, or service provider to carry out the shutdown, including through a court order.

A company-controlled kill switch alone does not qualify. Neither does authority limited to blocking future development or release, or a general power to regulate AI without authority to stop an operating system. The government need not own or physically operate the shutdown mechanism, and the authority need not be used before the deadline. A later effective date does not delay qualification.

An example of this is the AI Kill Switch Act (H.R. 9917).

markets.rules_primary: If France imposes capital controls before Jun 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Capital controls are a legally binding measure of general application, adopted by the French national government, the French Parliament or an independent French authority exercising binding powers under French law, that prohibits, restricts, caps, delays or requires prior approval for any of the following:
Transfers, payments or remittances of funds between France and other countries, or between residents and nonresidents of France
The conversion of euros into foreign currency, or the transfer of euros or foreign currency into or out of France
Cash withdrawals or transfers out of deposit or payment accounts in France, or surrenders of or withdrawals from life insurance or capitalization contracts, including withdrawal or transfer limits, deposit freezes and temporary bank closures (a "bank holiday")

A measure that requires foreign-currency funds or assets held abroad to be repatriated, surrendered or deposited also counts. A measure is of general application if it covers a class of persons, accounts, institutions or transactions defined by objective criteria; it does not need to cover all of France, and a limited or phased rollout counts.

The measure must take legal effect after this market is first listed and before Jun 1, 2027, determined by Paris time. A measure already in force that merely continues does not count; a new measure, a material expansion of an existing measure, or a re-imposition after it lapsed does. A measure that takes effect still counts if it is later suspended, narrowed, repealed or annulled.

The following do NOT count:
An announcement, proposal, draft bill, draft decree or scheduled future effective date, until the measure actually takes effect
Measures adopted solely by the European Union, the European Central Bank, another supranational body, or regional or local authorities
Measures applying only to one identified financial institution or to specifically named persons or entities
Sanctions, asset freezes and embargoes; foreign investment screening; taxes, levies and fees; short-selling bans and trading halts; and limits on cash payments
Anti-money-laundering, due diligence and reporting requirements that do not prohibit, cap, delay or require approval for the movement of funds
Standing holding periods, lock-ups and early-withdrawal conditions of savings, retirement or insurance products, other than a temporary suspension, delay or limit on withdrawals, transfers or surrenders
markets.title: Will France impose capital controls before Jun 1, 2027?

markets.rules_primary: If France imposes capital controls before Sep 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Capital controls are a legally binding measure of general application, adopted by the French national government, the French Parliament or an independent French authority exercising binding powers under French law, that prohibits, restricts, caps, delays or requires prior approval for any of the following:
Transfers, payments or remittances of funds between France and other countries, or between residents and nonresidents of France
The conversion of euros into foreign currency, or the transfer of euros or foreign currency into or out of France
Cash withdrawals or transfers out of deposit or payment accounts in France, or surrenders of or withdrawals from life insurance or capitalization contracts, including withdrawal or transfer limits, deposit freezes and temporary bank closures (a "bank holiday")

A measure that requires foreign-currency funds or assets held abroad to be repatriated, surrendered or deposited also counts. A measure is of general application if it covers a class of persons, accounts, institutions or transactions defined by objective criteria; it does not need to cover all of France, and a limited or phased rollout counts.

The measure must take legal effect after this market is first listed and before Sep 1, 2027, determined by Paris time. A measure already in force that merely continues does not count; a new measure, a material expansion of an existing measure, or a re-imposition after it lapsed does. A measure that takes effect still counts if it is later suspended, narrowed, repealed or annulled.

The following do NOT count:
An announcement, proposal, draft bill, draft decree or scheduled future effective date, until the measure actually takes effect
Measures adopted solely by the European Union, the European Central Bank, another supranational body, or regional or local authorities
Measures applying only to one identified financial institution or to specifically named persons or entities
Sanctions, asset freezes and embargoes; foreign investment screening; taxes, levies and fees; short-selling bans and trading halts; and limits on cash payments
Anti-money-laundering, due diligence and reporting requirements that do not prohibit, cap, delay or require approval for the movement of funds
Standing holding periods, lock-ups and early-withdrawal conditions of savings, retirement or insurance products, other than a temporary suspension, delay or limit on withdrawals, transfers or surrenders

markets.rules_primary: If federal legislation restricting exports of advanced AI chips or semiconductor manufacturing equipment has become law after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying federal law must impose a binding restriction or requirement on exports of advanced AI chips or of semiconductor manufacturing equipment or components. Export bans, license requirements or licensing standards, location-verification or other end-use security mechanisms on exported chips, mandatory congressional review of chip export licenses, and directives requiring the Bureau of Industry and Security to impose such controls, including by writing existing controls into statute, qualify. The restriction may be part of a broader law, such as the National Defense Authorization Act, and a later effective date does not delay qualification.

Studies, reports, briefings, funding, sense-of-Congress provisions, and controls only on other goods, on investment, or on remote or cloud access to chips do not qualify. General sanctions, embargoes, or entity listings that restrict all exports to a country or company, without a restriction specific to chips or chipmaking equipment, do not qualify.

An example of this is the Chip Security Act, which would require location verification on exported advanced AI chips.

markets.rules_primary: If federal legislation requiring independent AI safety evaluations or audits has become law after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying federal law must require a safety evaluation or audit of AI models, systems, or safety practices by an evaluator independent of the entity being reviewed. Government evaluators and independent outside organizations qualify. The review must substantively assess safety risks, testing, safeguards, or risk management; disclosure paperwork or self-attestation alone does not qualify.

The law may cover a defined class of models or entities and may delegate technical standards to an agency. Self-assessments, voluntary programs, studies, and reviews limited to privacy, fairness, or transparency without a safety component do not qualify. A later effective date does not delay qualification.

An example of this is the FRONTIER Act (H.R. 9925).

markets.rules_primary: If any AI lab solves another Millennium Prize Problem after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A Millennium Prize Problem counts as solved on the first date that, by Expiration, remains unretracted and either:

A complete proof, disproof, or counterexample addressing the problem as originally formulated by the Clay Mathematics Institute is published in a reputable peer-reviewed mathematics or scientific journal.
CMI or another recognized academic governing or recognition body officially states that the problem has been resolved by reference to a specific written work.
At least two Source Agencies themselves report that the problem has been proven, disproven, or otherwise resolved by reference to a specific publicly available written work.

A preprint, announcement, blog post, conference presentation, technical report, or machine-checked formalization does NOT by itself constitute a solution, but may be the written work relied upon for official recognition or qualifying Source Agency reporting. Award of a Millennium Prize by CMI is NOT required.

Partial results, special cases, unrelated reformulations, results conditional on unproven assumptions, and findings that the problem is independent of or undecidable within its framework do NOT count. The result must establish the truth or falsity of the problem as originally formulated.

A solution is attributed to AI lab when Source Agencies report that AI lab, its personnel, or an AI system developed and operated by it produced the solution in whole or substantial part, and the lab or system is credited as an author, contributor, or producer. Collaborative work qualifies; independent third-party use of the lab's publicly available model or product without such participation or credit does NOT.

Each Millennium Prize Problem counts at most once. Problems solved before time period do NOT count. A purported solution that is retracted, withdrawn, repudiated, rescinded, disavowed, or reported to contain an unresolved identified error before Expiration does NOT count.

markets.rules_primary: If federal legislation imposing an AI catastrophic-risk duty of care has become law after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying federal law must impose an enforceable standard requiring AI developers or deployers to take reasonable care, or equivalent precautions, to prevent or mitigate catastrophic harm from their models or systems. Catastrophic harm refers to large-scale harm such as mass casualties, major disruption of critical infrastructure, or comparably severe economic or environmental damage; the law need not use the exact phrase "duty of care".

A law requiring only a framework, audit, report, or shutdown control does NOT count. A framework qualifies only when the law makes the adequacy of the developer's precautions against catastrophic harm an enforceable obligation. Government enforcement or civil liability may enforce the duty. A later effective date does not delay qualification.

An example of this is the catastrophic-risk duty-of-care proposal being negotiated by Senators John Thune, Ted Cruz, and Amy Klobuchar.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the takeover succeeds as defined in the Payout Criterion (both corporate approval and conditions satisfaction announcements made).
markets.rules_primary: If qualifying public announcements indicate NextEra Energy, Inc.'s takeover of Dominion Energy, Inc. has succeeded Before 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: A takeover "succeeds" when BOTH of the following are publicly announced: (a) Corporate Approval—shareholders approved the acquisition OR the acquirer acquired controlling interest (  50% of voting shares); AND (b) Conditions Satisfaction—all material conditions including regulatory approvals have been satisfied or waived. Press releases, SEC filings (8-K, Schedule TO amendments), and official company announcements qualify. Letters of intent, agreements in principle, or conditional announcements do not satisfy the criteria. If one acquirer's takeover succeeds, all other acquirer markets immediately resolve to No. Resolution is based on the announcements, not the ultimate transaction outcome—if both criteria are announced but the deal later fails, the market still resolves to Yes. The "None" option resolves to Yes only if no takeover succeeds by the deadline.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
markets.rules_primary: If John Williams leaves as President of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
John Williams must have an actual departure date and vacate the role within the time period.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role, including both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

markets.rules_primary: If Widespread Panic performs at Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre in 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: For purposes of this contract, "performed" means the person appears live on stage or in the official broadcast/stream and performs (including singing, dancing, DJ-ing, or playing an instrument), either as a scheduled performer or as a guest appearance during another artist's performance. Guest appearances where the person performs live music qualify. Festival appearances that include a live set qualify. The following do not qualify: appearing only as an award presenter or host, being in the audience without performing, having music played without participation, appearing in video montages or tribute segments without performing, pre-show or post-show performances outside the official event timeframe, appearances without performing (speeches, award acceptances, interviews, promotional events), canceled or postponed shows where no performance occurs in the time period, rehearsals and sound checks, or virtual participation via livestream into the venue.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If legislation that adds or widens a legal ground for abortion, extends the gestational limit, or removes criminal or civil liability for abortion or for assisting one is enacted in Texas before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, a law easing Texas's abortion ban means a statute or constitutional amendment of Texas that adds or widens a legal ground on which abortion is legal, such as a new exception or a gestational limit that allows abortion at a stage the 2022 trigger ban (HB 1280) now prohibits, or that removes criminal or civil liability, in whole or in part, for abortion or for assisting one. It may contain other provisions and need not repeal any of the bans.

Rulings of the Texas Supreme Court or any other court, executive orders, enforcement decisions of the Attorney General, and measures that only change hospital procedures, reporting or funding, or only clarify or restate care already permitted under existing exceptions, without adding or widening a ground or removing criminal or civil liability do NOT count. Passage by the Texas Legislature alone, and a bill the Governor has vetoed without the Legislature overriding it, do NOT count.
markets.title: Will Texas enact a law easing its abortion ban before Jul 1, 2027?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the Payout Criterion is met. The latest expiration is the earlier of 14 days after the first day Anthropic's IPO shares trade on a national securities exchange and one year after issuance, at 10:00 AM ET.
markets.no_sub_title: Will Dario Amodei hold super-voting Anthropic shares at IPO?
markets.rules_primary: If Dario Amodei holds shares of Anthropic carrying more votes per share than the shares sold to the public immediately following Anthropic's IPO, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

SEC filings take priority, followed by the other sources listed in the full rules.
Ownership and votes per share are measured at the initial closing of Anthropic's IPO.

Payout Criteria

Dario Amodei holds shares with more votes per share than those sold to the public. Beneficial ownership, including through trusts or other entities, counts.
Votes are compared on a common-share-equivalent basis, including convertible shares and Up-C structures. Any qualifying holding counts, regardless of size.

Doesn't count for payout

Announcements, unexercised options, unsettled RSUs, or shares acquired only after that closing.
Veto or special board-election rights without higher votes per share.
Direct listings, SPAC transactions, or offerings outside SEC registration.
If a share is held through an entity and voted by majority decision of three or more individuals, none of whom can individually direct or block that vote, person does not "hold" that share by being one of those individuals. This does not apply if person can individually direct or block the vote, or if the share is reported as beneficially owned by person. It also does not apply if person can individually direct or block the share's disposition, or if the share is reported as beneficially owned by person in any Form 3, Form 4, Schedule 13D, or Schedule 13G.
Example that would NOT resolve the market to Yes:
Assuming person is Individual A, a hypothetical Anthropic co-founder: a Class F share carrying 50.1% of voting power is held by an LLC whose vote is directed by majority of seven co-founders, including Individual A. The final prospectus reports the share as held by the LLC, not Individual A. The Contract resolves No, because Individual A cannot direct or block the vote alone

Expiration and no IPO

Latest expiration: 10:00 AM ET on the earlier of 14 days after IPO shares first trade or one year after issuance. The market may close early if the payout criterion is met.
Resolves No if no qualifying IPO closes by expiration, or no source reports a qualifying holding by then.

Please see the full rules for more details.

markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying bill is legislation that raises or eliminates the cap on annual earnings subject to the Social Security payroll tax (the taxable maximum, $184,500 in 2026), including by applying the tax to earnings above a higher threshold.
The Social Security 2100 Act or a successor bill with the same effect qualifies.
Legislation that only raises the payroll tax rate, taxes investment income, changes benefits, or calls for a study or recommendations on the cap does NOT qualify.
The measure must pass the full House by any means, including voice vote, unanimous consent, suspension of the rules, a special rule or a discharge petition.
It may be any vehicle, including a larger package whose text as passed contains a qualifying change.
Committee approval, a rule providing for consideration, or a discharge petition reaching 218 signatures without passage does NOT count.
Senate passage and enactment do NOT count.

markets.rules_primary: If a formal decision calling a snap election to the National Council of the Slovak Republic and setting its voting date is issued before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A snap election is a national parliamentary election called as a result of a legally effective shortening of the National Council's term or its early dissolution.

The decision calling the election must be issued by a person or body with legal authority to call it and must set the voting date. Statements of intent and planned or expected dates do not qualify unless they officially record that the decision has been issued.

The decision counts if it is issued after Issuance and before the market's date.

Fox Corp., Index No. 151136/2021, or any appeal thereof before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Every claim Smartmatic still asserts against both Fox Corporation and Fox News Network, LLC must be dismissed. Claims that remain against any other defendant, and Fox's own counterclaims, do not prevent a YES.

The ruling must:
Be issued by a New York State court in Smartmatic USA Corp. v. Fox Corp., Index No. 151136/2021, or any appeal of it
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
The March 8, 2022 decision, or any later decision, holding that Smartmatic's claims have a substantial basis in law or that actual malice is adequately alleged
Denial of Fox's motion for summary judgment
An order that dismisses only some claims, some broadcasts or some defendants while the rest proceed
A jury verdict or a judgment entered on one
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders

Only a public announcement by the person or their official campaign that they are running counts, and it must be reported by a Source Agency. A run for any party's nomination, or as an independent or third-party candidate, counts.

Filing paperwork without a public announcement, such as an FEC statement of candidacy or ballot petitions
Forming an exploratory committee, or saying they are interested in or considering a run
Reports about their plans that do not come from them or their campaign
An announcement made before Issuance

A person who announces and later withdraws still resolves to YES.

Running for Vice President, including being named a running mate, does NOT count.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump Jr. is subpoenaed by a vote of a committee or subcommittee of the U.S. Senate after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency before Jan 1, 2028.

A person is subpoenaed by a committee vote only if a committee or subcommittee of the U.S. Senate, including a select committee, takes a recorded or voice vote, or agrees by unanimous consent, that approves a subpoena to that person or authorizes the chair to issue one to that person. A subpoena for documents, testimony, or both qualifies. The vote counts when it is taken, even if the subpoena is signed, served, or complied with later or never. A single vote covering several people counts for each of them.

The following do NOT count:
A subpoena issued by a chair or other member without a committee or subcommittee vote
A motion to subpoena that fails, is tabled, or is not put to a vote
A vote held before Issuance
A vote by a House committee
A subpoena addressed only to a company, agency, or office without naming the person
A court or grand jury subpoena
A vote that delegates subpoena authority generally without naming the person
A letter, request, or threat to subpoena, or a voluntary interview or deposition
markets.title: Will it be confirmed that Donald Trump Jr. is subpoenaed by a vote of a committee or subcommittee of the U.S. Senate?

markets.rules_primary: If Chuck Schumer wins the next Senate Democratic Leader election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market resolves based on the official certification or declaration by the relevant electoral authority. For parliamentary elections, the party or coalition with the most seats wins. For referendums, "Yes" and "No" are the options. For presidential or direct elections, the candidate who wins according to the electoral system (electoral college, popular vote, or runoff as applicable) is the winner. Markets resolve based on official results, not exit polls or projections. If elections are postponed beyond the expiration date, markets resolve to No. Contested results are resolved based on the final certified outcome by the appropriate electoral authority or highest court with jurisdiction.

markets.rules_primary: If any federal or state court rules that the pied-à-terre surcharge on non-primary residences in New York City, enacted by New York State in May 2026, violates the U.S. Constitution or the New York State Constitution, in whole or in part in a case challenging the constitutionality of that surcharge before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The ruling must:
Be issued by any federal or state court in a case challenging the constitutionality of that surcharge, meaning the pied-à-terre surcharge
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

Partial relief counts. A written ruling that the surcharge is unconstitutional only in part, or only as applied to one or more plaintiffs, qualifies. A qualifying ruling counts when issued, even if it is later stayed, vacated, or reversed.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
A ruling that rests only on statute, the city's rollout, tax notices, the supplemental tax roll, or a party's standing, without holding that the surcharge violates a constitution
A finding only that plaintiffs are likely to succeed, or a temporary restraining order or preliminary injunction that does not itself hold the surcharge unconstitutional
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders
Orders to show cause
Minute orders that do not address the substantive issue in the specified judgment

For clarity:
If the case is dismissed for lack of jurisdiction, that counts as a ruling only if the judgment refers to jurisdiction
Sua sponte rulings count if they match the specified judgment
Per curiam opinions and summary orders count as rulings
If multiple judges issue separate opinions, the majority/plurality opinion controls

markets.rules_primary: If any federal or state court issues a temporary restraining order, preliminary or permanent injunction, stay, vacatur, or judgment that blocks, enjoins, annuls, or declares invalid any part of New York City's ban on horse-drawn carriages passed by the City Council on October 22, 2026 (Int. No. 943-A, Romanch's Law) in a case challenging New York City's horse-drawn carriage ban before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The ruling must:
Be issued by any federal or state court in a case challenging New York City's horse-drawn carriage ban
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

Partial relief counts. A written ruling that blocks the ban only as applied to one or more plaintiffs, or only its expiration of carriage licenses or license plates, qualifies.

A temporary restraining order qualifies when it is issued in writing and its operative terms block or enjoin a covered part of the ban. It need not be converted or extended into a preliminary injunction.

A stay qualifies when the written order's operative terms block or enjoin the ban or its enforcement. A stay entered solely for briefing, scheduling, or other administrative case management does not qualify.

A qualifying ruling counts when issued, even if it is later stayed, vacated, or reversed.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
A ruling that addresses only compensation, the industry transition plan, or the disposition of horses, and does not block the prohibition on operating horse-drawn carriages or the expiration of carriage licenses or license plates
An agreement or stipulation of the parties not to enforce the ban, even if entered as an order of the court
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders
Orders to show cause
Minute orders that do not address the substantive issue in the specified judgment

For clarity:
If the case is dismissed for lack of jurisdiction, that counts as a ruling only if the judgment refers to jurisdiction
Sua sponte rulings count if they match the specified judgment
Per curiam opinions and summary orders count as rulings
If multiple judges issue separate opinions, the majority/plurality opinion controls

markets.rules_primary: If Elon Musk deposits SpaceX shares into the Trump Accounts of at least 10 million children after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency.

News confirmation is defined as a published article, broadcast segment, or official news report by a Source Agency, that A) explicitly states Elon Musk depositing SpaceX shares into the Trump Accounts of at least 10 million children occurred, is true, or has been verified, B) based on journalistic investigation, sources, or evidence, and C) presented as factual reporting rather than speculation, rumor, or unverified allegation.

This requires that SpaceX shares contributed by Elon Musk have been credited to the Trump Accounts of at least 10,000,000 children, with each of those accounts receiving at least one share. Deposits made in more than one round count together toward the 10,000,000. A Source Agency report that Musk's shares have been deposited into every eligible Trump Account, or into a group of accounts it puts at 10,000,000 or more, is sufficient.

Shares contributed by Elon Musk include shares given by any foundation, trust, or other entity he controls, or routed through any charity or intermediary, when the gift is part of his October 19, 2026 pledge or a Source Agency credits it to him. A Trump Account is an account established under Section 530A of the Internal Revenue Code, under any name, including an account opened automatically by the U.S. Department of the Treasury. If SpaceX merges with or is acquired by another company, is renamed, or otherwise reorganizes, shares of the company into which SpaceX shares were converted or exchanged count as SpaceX shares. One share means one share as adjusted for any stock split, reverse split, or stock dividend after Oct 19, 2026.

The following do NOT count:
A pledge, announcement, commitment, or agreement to deposit shares, or a transfer of shares to the Treasury or another intermediary, before the shares are credited to the children's accounts
Cash, or any payment equal to the value of a share, in place of SpaceX shares
SpaceX shares contributed by anyone other than Elon Musk, including the gift pledged by Gwynne Shotwell and her husband

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If a law banning assault weapons is enacted in Minnesota before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, a law banning assault weapons means a statute of Minnesota that prohibits the sale of a defined class of semi-automatic firearms, such as semiautomatic military-style assault weapons identified by features or listed models, or that prohibits possessing them. A law that bars sales by licensed dealers counts even if people who already own these firearms may keep, certify or resell them. It may contain other provisions.

A law that only limits magazine capacity, only requires registration, permits, background checks, training or safe storage, only regulates binary triggers, ghost guns or conversion devices, or only restricts who may buy or possess these firearms, without prohibiting their sale or possession, does NOT count. Executive orders do NOT count.

Enactment is measured when the law is enacted, not when its prohibitions take effect.

markets.rules_primary: If Delaware Superior Court sides with Brigitte Macron in Macron and Macron vs Owens (case number: N25C-07-194 CLS) before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For this market, the case is Emmanuel Macron and Brigitte Macron v. Candace Owens, Candace Owens LLC, and GeorgeTom, Inc., in the Superior Court of the State of Delaware, C.A. No. N25C-07-194.

Brigitte Macron achieves the superior outcome through the following exclusive hierarchy:

Net Monetary Recovery (Highest Priority): Brigitte Macron achieves the superior outcome if she receives a larger net monetary award than all opposing parties combined (after offsetting any awards against her), or receives any monetary award while opposing parties receive $0 net. Monetary awards include compensatory damages, punitive damages, restitution, and statutory damages. Attorney's fees and costs are excluded.

Substantive Legal Victory (Second Priority): If no net monetary advantage exists for any party, Brigitte Macron achieves the superior outcome if she prevails on the claims seeking the largest dollar amount of relief in her original pleadings. If relief amounts are equal or unclear, she achieves the superior outcome if she prevails on the greater number of primary causes of action.

Case Termination Advantage (Third Priority): If the case terminates without substantive judgment, Brigitte Macron achieves the superior outcome if opposing parties voluntarily dismiss all claims against her with prejudice. All other termination scenarios result in no superior outcome for any party.

Settlements:
If the parties settle with a disclosed net payment to Brigitte Macron, she achieves the superior outcome.
If the parties settle with a disclosed net payment from Brigitte Macron to opposing parties, she does not achieve the superior outcome.
If the parties settle with mutual releases and no disclosed payment direction, or if settlement terms are sealed and no Source Agency reports payment direction within 7 days of the settlement announcement, no party achieves a superior outcome.

Key exclusions: This market applies only to trial-level resolution and excludes all appeals processes. Only claims directly involving Brigitte Macron are considered. Procedural victories (discovery sanctions, fee awards alone, contempt citations) do not constitute superior outcomes unless accompanied by substantive relief on the merits. A ruling on a motion to dismiss that leaves claims pending is not a final resolution; a dismissal that ends the entire trial-level action is evaluated under the hierarchy above.

The ruling must:
Be issued by United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit in United States ex rel. Clarissa Zafirov v. Florida Medical Associates, LLC, et al.,
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders
Orders to show cause
Minute orders that do not address the substantive issue in the specified judgment

For clarity:
If the case is dismissed for lack of jurisdiction, that counts as a ruling only if the judgment refers to jurisdiction
Sua sponte rulings count if they match the specified judgment
Per curiam opinions and summary orders count as rulings
If multiple judges issue separate opinions, the majority/plurality opinion controls

A party is considered to be part of government if one or more of its representatives hold at least one ministerial or cabinet-level position (including junior ministers or equivalent executive roles, if applicable) in the new government. This evaluation shall occur at the first official, stable formation of the government (i.e., once the legislative process for forming a government is complete and the head of state appoints ministers under normal non-caretaker circumstances). 

Additionally,
A “confidence and supply arrangement” (or any analogous agreement), where a party does not hold formal cabinet or ministerial positions but has publicly agreed, through a formal written agreement or a widely recognized, explicitly stated political deal, to support the government on key votes (e.g., votes of confidence, budget/finance bills) without formally joining the cabinet or government, may be included in the Payout Criterion if specified in parties (e.g. parties could take the form of “The Conservative Party and the Liberal Party” as well as “The Conservative Party with the support of the Greens”).
If, following the election, a caretaker or interim government is appointed temporarily before the formal government formation, this caretaker period does not count for determining a given party’s status.

Additional clarification(s): 
Dissolution, absorption, or merger: If a party named in parties dissolves, is absorbed into, or merges with one or more other parties to form a new and distinct political party or organization prior to the relevant government formation, the originally named party shall not be considered part of government merely because its former politicians, officeholders, or assets have moved to, or been absorbed by, the new party. The resulting party is not treated as equivalent to the originally named party for purposes of this Contract, unless the circumstances instead satisfy the legal name change standard below, in which case that standard governs.
Legal name change: If a party named in parties undergoes a legal name change or rebranding but remains the same underlying legal political organization (i.e., the same legal registration, organizational continuity, and party structure persist, notwithstanding the new name), the renamed party continues to count as the same party named in parties.
Joint electoral list: If a party named in parties contests the election as part of a joint electoral list, alliance, or umbrella grouping:
  If the named party continues to exist as a distinct, separately identifiable constituent party under the umbrella list (rather than having been subsumed into it), the named party remains eligible to count toward the Payout Criterion, provided that a qualifying government officeholder (i.e., a minister, cabinet-level appointee, or equivalent executive role holder) represents, or is formally and publicly affiliated with, that named party specifically, as opposed to the umbrella list generically or another constituent party.
  If the joint list instead constitutes a newly consolidated party that legally replaces its constituent predecessors (such that the predecessor parties cease to exist as distinct legal or political entities), the predecessor parties named in parties do not count. Only the new consolidated party may count toward the Payout Criterion, and only if it is separately specified in parties or qualifies as a legal successor under the above legal name change clarification.

Clarification (08/03/26): To clarify, this event will resolve based on the composition of the first government formed after the election upon receiving the Knesset’s confidence. Each qualifying officeholder who contested the election will be attributed to the registered party identified for that person in the candidate list approved by Israel’s Central Elections Committee. An officeholder who did not contest the election will be attributed to the registered party expressly identified for that person in official government-formation records or, if those records are silent, a formal coalition agreement. A registered-party strike will resolve Yes if a qualifying officeholder is attributed to that party. A joint-list or alliance strike will resolve Yes if the named grouping contested the election jointly and a qualifying officeholder is attributed to any registered party that submitted the list. A candidate who formally withdraws from a list before the election will be treated as not having contested the election. If the named grouping does not contest the election, former constituents running separately will not count toward its strike. A post-election faction split will not alter a candidate’s CEC-recorded affiliation. Legal party mergers, dissolutions, and name changes remain governed by the existing rules.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If a measure ending Iowa's private Medicaid managed care contracts is enacted in Iowa before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature and issuance, and publication in official government records

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, ending privatized Medicaid means an Iowa law, a Governor's executive order, or a formal written notice by the Iowa Department of Health and Human Services that terminates or does not renew every Medicaid managed care contract the state then holds with Iowa Total Care, Molina Healthcare or Wellpoint (a contract that has already ended does not need to be included). It counts whether or not it names the state or nonprofit organizations as the replacement. A measure that requires federal approval counts once enacted or issued, even if the contracts end after the deadline.

An order that only begins a review, study or transition plan, an action that ends some but not all of those contracts, and ending the contracts in order to award them to other for-profit insurers do NOT count.

markets.rules_primary: If the FDA approves any psychedelic substance for medical use for marketing before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Psychedelic drugs include: LSD, Psilocybin, DMT, Mescaline, MDMA, MDA, PCP, DXM, Ibogaine, Salvia divinorum, 2C family, and Ayahuasca.

Important information: For purposes of this Contract:

The listed substances are illustrative, not exhaustive. Approval of any other substance commonly recognized in scientific or FDA documentation as a psychedelic, hallucinogen, or entactogen (for example, psilocin, 5-MeO-DMT, methylone, or 2C-, DOx-, or NBOMe-family compounds) may also satisfy the Payout Criterion.

"Approval for medical use" means an FDA approval letter for an NDA or BLA authorizing marketing of a drug or biologic for human medical use in the United States, where a listed (or otherwise qualifying) psychedelic substance is an active pharmaceutical ingredient of the approved product. Complete Response Letters, tentative approvals, Emergency Use Authorizations, expanded access or compassionate use authorizations, and approvals limited to export do not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

Combination products. Approval of a combination drug product satisfies the Payout Criterion only if at least one active ingredient is a listed (or otherwise qualifying) psychedelic substance and that psychedelic active ingredient has not previously been approved by the FDA via NDA or BLA for any human medical indication. By way of example, an FDA approval of AXS-05 (a combination of dextromethorphan and bupropion) for a new indication does not satisfy the Payout Criterion, because both active ingredients were FDA-approved prior to Issuance.

New indications for previously-approved substances. An FDA approval (including via supplemental NDA or supplemental BLA) of a new medical indication, dosage, or formulation for a substance whose active pharmaceutical ingredient was already approved by the FDA via NDA or BLA prior to Issuance does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has achieved the superior outcome in the trial-level resolution of Donald J. Trump v. British Broadcasting Corporation (originally filed in the United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida), then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Donald Trump achieves the superior outcome through the following exclusive hierarchy:

Net Monetary Recovery (Highest Priority): Donald Trump achieves the superior outcome if they receive a larger net monetary award than all opposing parties combined (after offsetting any awards against Donald Trump). Attorney's fees and costs are excluded.

Substantive Legal Victory (Second Priority): If no net monetary advantage exists, Donald Trump achieves the superior outcome if they prevail on claims seeking the largest dollar amount of relief in their original pleadings, or if relief amounts are equal, on the greater number of primary causes of action.

Case Termination Advantage (Third Priority): If the case terminates without substantive judgment, Donald Trump achieves the superior outcome if (as defendant) all claims are dismissed with prejudice, or (as plaintiff) opposing parties voluntarily dismiss all claims with prejudice. All other termination scenarios result in no superior outcome for any party.

Settlements: If parties settle with a disclosed net payment to Donald Trump, Donald Trump achieves the superior outcome. If parties settle with a disclosed net payment from Donald Trump to opposing parties, Donald Trump does not achieve the superior outcome. If parties settle with mutual releases and no disclosed payment direction, or if settlement terms are sealed and no Source Agency reports payment direction within 7 days of settlement announcement, no party achieves a superior outcome.

Key exclusions: Applies only to trial-level resolution — specifically excludes all appeals processes. Procedural victories alone do not constitute superior outcomes.

markets.rules_primary: If Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell has achieved the superior outcome in the trial-level resolution of their law suit against Anthropic (Case 5:26-cv-09217) (originally filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, San Jose Division), then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell achieves the superior outcome through the following exclusive hierarchy:

Net Monetary Recovery (Highest Priority): Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell achieves the superior outcome if they receive a larger net monetary award than all opposing parties combined (after offsetting any awards against Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell). Attorney's fees and costs are excluded.

Substantive Legal Victory (Second Priority): If no net monetary advantage exists, Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell achieves the superior outcome if they prevail on claims seeking the largest dollar amount of relief in their original pleadings, or if relief amounts are equal, on the greater number of primary causes of action.

Case Termination Advantage (Third Priority): If the case terminates without substantive judgment, Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell achieves the superior outcome if (as defendant) all claims are dismissed with prejudice, or (as plaintiff) opposing parties voluntarily dismiss all claims with prejudice. All other termination scenarios result in no superior outcome for any party.

Settlements: Superior outcome if net payment flows to Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell; no superior outcome if payment flows from Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell; no party achieves superior outcome if terms are sealed or undisclosed.

Key exclusions: Applies only to trial-level resolution — specifically excludes all appeals processes. Procedural victories alone do not constitute superior outcomes.

markets.rules_primary: If a United Nations member state moves its capital city to a new city before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A capital change counts once a law, constitutional amendment, executive decree or other legally binding government act made after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028 explicitly designates a new city as the capital of a United Nations member state, replacing the previous capital. The act must either move the executive, legislature and courts to a new city or make it the official capital even if some government functions stay elsewhere. It counts even if the move takes effect after Jan 1, 2028.

These do not count:
Announcements, plans or proposals without legal effect
A temporary, provisional, interim or administrative capital
Moving only some government functions while the official capital stays elsewhere
Preparatory acts such as land purchases, construction or budgets
A de facto move without a legal designation

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the arrest occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Benjamin Netanyahu has been arrested before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this Contract, "arrested" means:
Being taken into physical custody by law enforcement authorities (including federal, state, local, military, or international law enforcement)
Voluntarily surrendering to law enforcement authorities in response to an arrest warrant
Being formally booked or processed following detention

The following scenarios would satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Benjamin Netanyahu is handcuffed and taken to a police station
Benjamin Netanyahu surrenders at a police station or courthouse with their attorney
Benjamin Netanyahu is arrested in any country and this is reported by a Source Agency
Benjamin Netanyahu is detained at an airport or border crossing and formally arrested

The following scenarios would NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
An arrest warrant being issued but not executed
Benjamin Netanyahu being briefly detained but not arrested
Benjamin Netanyahu being questioned or interviewed without arrest
Benjamin Netanyahu being placed under house arrest or electronic monitoring without physical custody
Benjamin Netanyahu being named in an indictment without arrest
Benjamin Netanyahu being arrested after Oct 1, 2026
Protective custody that is not an arrest
markets.title: Will Benjamin Netanyahu be arrested before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit affirms the April 8, 2025 preliminary injunction as it applies to the Oval Office, Air Force One or Mar-a-Lago in Associated Press v. Budowich, No. 25-5109 before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The ruling must:
Be issued by the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit in Associated Press v. Budowich, No. 25-5109
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

A panel decision and a decision of the court sitting en banc both count. An affirmance as to any one of the Oval Office, Air Force One or Mar-a-Lago is enough, and partial affirmance counts.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
An affirmance limited to the East Room, which the June 6, 2025 stay order already left in force
The June 6, 2025 stay order, and the July 22, 2025 order denying en banc reconsideration of it
Any order granting, modifying, extending, lifting or denying a stay
Reversal or vacatur of the preliminary injunction, or a remand for further proceedings
Any ruling of the U.S. Supreme Court
Settlements or voluntary dismissals

Restoration of Associated Press access to these spaces without a qualifying ruling, whether through a change in White House press practice or otherwise, does not resolve this market to YES.

If no qualifying ruling is issued after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, this market resolves to NO.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the person announces their candidacy.
markets.rules_primary: If Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez has announced that she will run for President of the United States in 2028 before Jan 1, 2027, including running for the nomination of any political party to contest that office, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only a public announcement by the person or their official campaign that they are running counts, and it must be reported by a Source Agency. A run for any party's nomination, or as an independent or third-party candidate, counts.

The following do NOT count:
Filing paperwork without a public announcement, such as an FEC statement of candidacy or ballot petitions
Forming an exploratory committee, or saying they are interested in or considering a run
Reports about their plans that do not come from them or their campaign
An announcement made before Issuance

A person who announces and later withdraws still resolves to YES.

Running for Vice President, including being named a running mate, does NOT count.
